Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 3
Reason for Mistake: The Planner misinterpreted the scope of “our nation’s history,” selecting the 1762 Battle of Manila (British capture during the Seven Years’ War) which predates the United States and is not typically considered part of U.S. national history. By using 1762 as the referent for “Battle of Manila,” the Planner concluded it occurred earlier than the Seven Days Battles (1862), leading to an incorrect answer. The Planner also finalized the task without verifying which Manila battle was intended (commonly 1898 or 1945 in U.S. history), resulting in a premature and scope-mismatched conclusion.
